title: Teammate messages
summary: Drafts messages to teammates very short and casual, in the language you choose.
details: When you ask for a message to send a colleague, Claude drafts it very short and casual in the language you chose at setup: a few lines with what you need, links and why now, keeping technical names, keys and commands as they are, and skipping formal greetings, sign-offs and emojis. Use it for the quick chat, Teams or Telegram notes you send during work. It is one short text rule file loaded in every session; no code runs and no network is used.

values.ask: Language and alphabet for messages to teammates

risk: A short rule file loaded every session. No hooks, no network.
